faqs.q: What is Fawtara?
faqs.a: Fawtara is the Oman Tax Authority's e-invoicing programme. VAT-registered businesses issue structured, machine-readable e-invoices that are validated and reported through a Peppol-based network.

faqs.q: When does e-invoicing start in Oman?
faqs.a: The rollout is in phases, starting with the largest taxpayers. Our compliance guide keeps the phases and dates up to date.

faqs.q: Which format does XionERP use?
faqs.a: UBL 2.1, aligned with Peppol BIS 3.0 and the Omani PINT-OM specification.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate e-invoicing system?
faqs.a: No. The e-invoice comes from the same sales invoice you raise today, so there is nothing to re-key.

faqs.q: Does XionERP support Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing?
faqs.a: Not yet. XionERP is built for Oman's Fawtara first. Contact us if you need ZATCA so we can tell you the timeline.
